fields.title: 2. DealBook Remarks — Merger and Compensation (T6 Candidate Table)
fields.md:
| Item | Content | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Setting | NYT DealBook Summit, 2026-11-18 · question from Sorkin | ⑥ [Benzinga (Yahoo published version)](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/elon-musk-says-shouldn-t-163042794.html), 2026-11-19 11:30 EST |
| Remarks | A merger satisfying the Tesla compensation conditions would be 'That would be unreasonable and not right' · the two companies may remain separate and Tesla shareholders may vote it down | Same |
| Not stated | Whether compensation already received would be returned | Same |
| Market reference | Polymarket 'official announcement within 2026' about 16% (down from 31% after the 11/12 Bloomberg report) | Same |

- **Judgment layer**: These are statements of intent, not grounds for a determination. They go only in the candidate table. Merger completion, exchange ratio and application of the compensation clauses are confirmed only through an 8-K and a proxy statement (S-4/DEFM14A). There are no related SpaceX or Tesla filings (Source: `state.musk_statements_as_milestone_candidates_only` · [EDGAR submissions](https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001181412.json), 2026-11-20 KST).
- **Proposal ① (definitive merger agreement → Base −5 · Bear +5)**: There is no agreement, so it is not subject to review (Source: `state.rule_proposals_not_applied`).
